capabilities: Schedule a reminder from a date-and-time property named in the note
Send a system notification on desktop and an in-app notice on mobile
Open the note when the notification is clicked
Watch multiple reminder properties, including separate date and time pairs
Restrict reminder scanning to selected folders
extras: Marked as in development and not yet released; tested only on macOS; on mobile, notifications appear only inside Obsidian while it is open.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get notified when a date or time stored in a note's property arrives.
summary: Reminder plugin that watches date-and-time properties in notes and sends a notification that opens the note when clicked.
